description: A health insurance premium invoice, billing statement, or payment confirmation from an insurer or marketplace, showing the recurring premium amount and billing period. Used to verify health-insurance-premium expenses, distinct from a one-time insurer notice letter.

insurer_or_marketplace_name.instruction: The name of the insurance company or health insurance marketplace issuing the statement.

policyholder_name.instruction: The full name of the policyholder.

employer_name.instruction: The name of the employer sponsoring the health plan, if this is an employer-sponsored premium statement.

policy_or_member_id.instruction: The policy or member identification number referenced on the statement.

coverage_start_date.instruction: Start of the billing or coverage period. YYYY-MM-DD format.

coverage_end_date.instruction: End of the billing or coverage period. YYYY-MM-DD format.

premium_amount.instruction: The premium amount billed or due for the period.

payment_frequency.instruction: How often the premium is billed, such as monthly, quarterly, or annually.

payment_due_date.instruction: The date the premium payment is due. YYYY-MM-DD format.

payment_status.instruction: Determine the payment status of the statement based on context, such as amounts due, payment confirmations, or due dates. Normalize to one of: Paid, Due, or Past Due.

subsidy_or_tax_credit_amount.instruction: The amount of any premium subsidy or tax credit applied, if shown.

statement_date.instruction: The date the statement was issued. YYYY-MM-DD format.
